claims.description: Table 1 col 1: ShannonBD on PSI, county + year-month FE, no controls
claims.code:
import json, os, warnings
import pandas as pd
import pyfixest as pf
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
df = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(os.environ["WORK_DIR"], "analysis.parquet"))
d = df
# reghdfe ShannonBD PI, absorb(county ym) cluster(...)
m = pf.feols("ShannonBD ~ PI | county + ym", d, vcov={"CRV1": "county"}, fixef_rm="singleton")
print("RESULT_JSON: " + json.dumps({"b": float(m.coef()["PI"]), "se": float(m.se()["PI"]), "n": int(m._N)}))

variants.name: Drop effort control (Duration)
variants.why: Shows how much the estimate leans on the one effort control.

variants.name: Add log number of birdwatchers
variants.why: Observer counts drive recorded diversity; the comments on the paper argue this is the key confounder.

variants.name: Add log total birdwatching hours
variants.why: Total effort, not effort per person, sets how many species get recorded.

variants.name: Flexible effort: observer-count bins
variants.why: Non-parametric control for observers, in case the log form is wrong.

variants.name: Only county-months with 5+ birdwatchers
variants.why: Drops thinly observed cells where Shannon diversity is mostly noise.

variants.name: Outcome not winsorized
variants.why: Checks that the 1/99 winsorizing does not drive the result.

variants.name: Cluster SE by city
variants.why: Policy is partly set at city level, so errors may correlate within cities.

variants.name: Province x year-month fixed effects
variants.why: Absorbs province-wide shocks such as provincial policy and reporting campaigns.

variants.name: Drop 2014-2016
variants.why: Early years have very few records on the platform.
